title: Old Grudges
summary: Tian Dao Sect master Wu Cunsu has to bow to Teng Xuan, a nineteenth-generation branch member of the Teng family, who warns him that the sect exists only to guard what lies under the capital. Wang Lin smashes the sect's protective formation and kills Wu Cunsu with one move, and the terrified Teng Xuan hands over a map of nine spiritual veins Teng Huayuan built under Zhao to strip mortals of their spiritual roots and feed them to the Teng family. Ji Mo, a mid Nascent Soul guest elder of the Teng family, comes to rescue Teng Xuan and explains that the veins feed nine core Nascent Soul cultivators who keep the Teng family the strongest in Zhao. Wang Lin reminds him of his disciple Bai Zhan, who died 400 years ago, and of the killers Ji Mo hired that set off the massacre in the Teng family city, and Ji Mo realises he is the Qi Condensation boy from back then. Wang Lin kills him and vows to kill the nine Nascent Souls one by one and destroy their veins so Teng Huayuan watches his family fall.
